checks.name: expired_witness_key_refuses_the_current_anchor
checks.detail: Evaluated at the current date, the pinned witness inventory's key window has lapsed, so the gate refuses with recovery_anchor_witness_inventory_rejected before any claimant is written.

checks.name: quarantined_record_refuses_even_when_trust_is_current
checks.detail: Evaluated inside the key window, the same live record verifies and is then refused with recovery_continuity_not_established. C1's refusal is therefore doubly determined, and the two causes are recorded separately rather than as one outcome.

checks.name: unreachable_anchor_store_refuses
checks.detail: With the store pointed at a table the identity cannot read, the gate refuses with startup_attestation_authority_unavailable and never opens a claimant.

checks.name: beacon_from_another_cluster_refuses
checks.detail: A signed beacon whose system identifier differs from the live database is refused with recovery_continuity_beacon_mismatch.

checks.name: beacon_ahead_of_this_database_refuses
checks.detail: A signed beacon whose durable WAL position is ahead of this database is refused with recovery_continuity_beacon_mismatch. This is the stale-attachment direction; the G11 catch-up boundary is unchanged by it.

checks.name: checkpoint_the_witness_does_not_attest_refuses
checks.detail: When the retained checkpoint digest and the signed witness disagree, the gate refuses with startup_checkpoint_digest_mismatch.

checks.name: checkpoint_bound_to_another_ledger_refuses
checks.detail: A retained checkpoint bound to a different ledger is refused before any authority is granted.

invariant: Every case is a refusal, and each asserts that the count of active claimants for the tested environment stayed zero. No refusal left a startable claimant behind.
not_performed: any DynamoDB write, signed transition, or commissioning
key generation or signing of any kind
any change to the commissioned staging ledger, which was never connected
notes: The synthetic established transitions used by the C1-T cases exist only in memory and were never written to DynamoDB.
The disposable database also holds claimants from the earlier D1 and M2 proofs, so the invariant is scoped to the environment under test.
The expired twelve-hour witness key remains the blocker for any live authority. Replacing it is a separate offline signing ceremony, not part of this proof.
